title: 第十三章 拿人钱财替人消灾第十章 一老一少一曲一琴
slug: 民国戏子请叫我武道宗师
content_zh:
同和居。
西四牌楼的老字号，也就是因为那道“三不沾”闻名京城。
今儿个晚上，这同和居二楼的雅间，被庆和班包了场。
刘管事穿着一身崭新的绸缎褂子，手里盘着两颗核桃，坐在主位上。
旁边坐着的，正是那个背叛师门，投奔了庆和班的“小盛云”。
这小盛云长得确实俊俏，面白红唇，一双桃花眼，透着股子阴柔气。
此时他正翘着二郎腿，手里夹着根“哈得门”香烟，一脸的不屑。
“刘叔，您说那陆诚敢来吗？”
小盛云吐了个烟圈。
“就他那个木头脑袋，就算练了几天把式，也是个没见过世面的土包子。这同和居的大门冲哪开，他怕是都不知道吧？”
刘管事嘿嘿一笑，眼里闪着毒光。
“他不来最好。”
“他不来，明儿个我就让人传出去，说他陆诚是缩头乌龟，怕了咱们庆和班。到时候，他在台上就算演出了花儿，这名声也臭了。”
“他要是来了……”
刘管事看了一眼坐在角落里一直没说话的一个壮汉。
那壮汉穿着一件黑色的对襟短褂，双臂抱胸，肌肉像岩石一样隆起。
最引人注目的是他的一双手，比常人大了一圈，手背上全是厚厚的老茧，黑得发亮。
这是“铁砂掌”练到家的标志。
“那就得让咱们这位‘贵客’，好好教教他怎么做人。”
刘管事阴恻恻地说道。

这壮汉叫雷老虎，是天桥这一带有名的打行教头，收钱办事，下手极黑。
“刘管事放心。”
雷老虎声音闷闷的，像是在瓮里说话。
“拿人钱财，替人消灾。待会儿只要那一摔杯为号，我就废了他的一条胳膊。”
正说着，楼梯口传来一阵脚步声。
不急不缓，沉稳有力。
“来了。”
雅间里的众人精神一震。
帘子一挑。
陆诚走了进来。
身后只跟着一个拉着胡琴的瞎子，阿炳。
一老一少，一瞎一明。
看着寒酸，但那气场，却莫名地压得屋里人呼吸一滞。
陆诚目光扫过全场，最后落在了小盛云身上。
小盛云被这目光一扫，手里夹着的烟差点没抖掉，下意识地把脚从椅子上放了下来。
content_en:
Living together.
The time-honored brand of Xisi Archway is famous in the capital because of its "three no-sticks".
Tonight, the private room on the second floor of Tonghe Residence was reserved by the Qinghe class.
Manager Liu was wearing a brand new silk gown, sitting on the main seat with two walnuts in his hand.
Sitting next to him was "Xiao Shengyun" who betrayed his master and defected to the Qinghe class.
This little Shengyun is indeed handsome, with a white face and red lips, a pair of peach blossom eyes, and an air of femininity.
At this time, he was crossing his legs, holding a Hardwood cigarette in his hand, with a look of disdain on his face.
"Uncle Liu, do you think Lu Cheng dares to come?"
Xiao Shengyun blew out a smoke ring.
"With his wooden head, even if he has practiced the moves for a few days, he is still a country bumpkin who has never seen the world. I'm afraid he doesn't even know where to open the door of Tongheju, right?"
Manager Liu chuckled, his eyes flashing with poison.
"It would be best if he didn't come."
"If he doesn't come, tomorrow I will let people spread the word that Lu Cheng is a coward and is afraid of our Qinghe class. By then, even if he performs Hua'er on stage, his reputation will be ruined."
"If he comes..."
Manager Liu glanced at a strong man sitting in the corner who had been silent.
The strong man was wearing a black double-breasted jacket, his arms were folded across his chest, and his muscles were bulging like rocks.
The most eye-catching thing was his hands, which were larger than ordinary people. The backs of his hands were covered with thick calluses, which were shiny black.
This is a sign that you have mastered "Iron Palm".
"Then we have to let our 'distinguished guest' teach him how to behave."
Manager Liu said sadly.
This strong man's name is Lei Laohu, and he is a well-known gang leader in the Tianqiao area. He collects money to do things, and his tactics are very shady.
"Don't worry, Manager Liu."
Thunder Tiger's voice was muffled, as if he was talking in an urn.
"Take people's money to help them eliminate disasters. Later, as long as I drop the cup as a sign, I will cripple one of his arms."
Just as he was talking, there was a sound of footsteps coming from the stairs.
Not hasty, not slow, steady and powerful.
"Coming."
Everyone in the private room was shocked.
The curtain lifted.
Lu Cheng walked in.
Behind him was only a blind man, A Bing, playing the huqin.
One is old and the other is young, one is blind and the other is sighted.
It looked shabby, but the aura inexplicably made the people in the room breathless.
Lu Cheng's eyes swept across the audience, and finally landed on Xiao Shengyun.
Xiao Shengyun was glanced at by this gaze. He almost shook off the cigarette in his hand and subconsciously put his feet down from the chair.
